summary: Compressed discussion signals: multiple user reports of agent data leaks and sandbox/MCP gaps, vendor-level agent features (Cursor, Epic, Google guidance), and emergent infra tooling (sandbox-mcp, devvm). Priorities: verify vendor confirmations and security advisories. | Vendor-only roundup: high-severity Claude Code and mem0 advisories, major vendor releases (JetBrains, Mistral, AWS), Bedrock model & eval guidance, and several vendor how-tos and sandbox/product updates. | GitHub-only snapshot: mix of major vendor releases and high‑star agent projects (Qwen, Google Gemini, Vercel, Dify, HTML-Anything) plus infra primitives for memory, MCP, and security.
